title: After Russian Diesel Deal, Trump Faces New Crisis Over Ukraine
partialText: President Trump’s surprise decision to suspend sanctions on Russian diesel fuel stunned Ukrainian and European officials, who were meeting with U.S. envoys at an exclusive golf club near Miami.

title: Trump Gives Putin a Hand in Russia’s Economic War With Ukraine
partialText: President Trump is moving to buy Russian diesel while also pressuring Ukraine to halt attacks on refineries, a lifeblood of Moscow’s war machine.

title: NATO Details Plan to Shield Ukraine’s European Allies From Russia
partialText: With the Russians intensifying sabotage, arson and cyberattacks against European nations supporting Ukraine, NATO divulged a blueprint, in case of war, to deter the Kremlin.

title: A Trump Loyalist, a Turkish Investor and a Battle for Wealth and Influence
partialText: A Turkish businessman once allied with the Maduro regime has tied the knot with President Trump’s former personal lawyer, Alina Habba, at the same time he is seeking to retain a big contract in Venezuela.

title: Federal Agents Search Home of Rep. Ilhan Omar
partialText: The search takes place within the 60-day window of the midterm elections, when the Justice Department has historically avoided such investigative steps related to political candidates.

title: Who’s Winning the Race for Congress?
partialText: It’s Oct. 12 — 22 days away from the midterms. Here’s the state of play.

title: An Ad Targeting Susan Collins’s Opponent, Troy Jackson, Airs in the Wrong Portland
partialText: An executive with the Republican super PAC that paid for the ad attacking Mr. Jackson, the Democratic Senate candidate in Maine, blamed its vendor for running the ad in Oregon.

title: How American Retirees at Different Incomes Rely on Social Security
partialText: Social Security funds are on track to run short by 2032, which would mean a reduction in benefits. Here’s how four hypothetical households rely on the program in retirement.

title: How to Buy and Eat Seafood Ethically
partialText: Our investigation into the farmed fish industry found human-rights violations and health concerns. Here’s what you can do.

title: Judge Orders Trump Administration to Answer for Tree Removals at D.C. Golf Course
partialText: During a four-hour hearing, a federal judge demanded answers from the Trump administration about who authorized the removal of hundreds of trees at the East Potomac Golf Links.

title: Blakeman Launches Graphic Attack on Mamdani in Meeting With Hasidic Jews
partialText: While seeking support from Hasidic leaders, the Republican candidate for governor, Bruce Blakeman, said Mayor Zohran Mamdani would not act if riots hit their community.

title: RJ Mitte, Who Played Walter White’s Son on ‘Breaking Bad,’ Dies at 34
partialText: Mr. Mitte was born with cerebral palsy and brought his own experience of living with the disability to the role of Walter White Jr. on the Emmy-winning show.

title: A Trove of Truman Capote’s Possessions Is Up for Auction
partialText: Four decades after his death, a revealing trove of the author’s possessions is up for auction.

title: One Grieving Mother, Two Mariners Tickets and a Season of New Friends
partialText: Rhenda Strub invited strangers to accompany her to Seattle Mariners games this season to help overcome the loneliness of grieving for her son’s death.

title: Meta Unveils New Series of Advanced A.I. Models
partialText: The new models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, are meant to compete with cutting-edge A.I. models from rivals like Anthropic and OpenAI.

title: With My Father’s Alzheimer’s Progressing, I Learned to See Beyond the Loss
partialText: Making a book of my dad’s train photos shifted my gaze away from all that he was losing.

title: A TikTok Tarot Card Reader Accused Me of Murder. My Life Turned Upside Down.
partialText: If my face and name were not my own, who was I?

title: Lower East Side Parishioners Mourn Loss of ‘Spiritual Home’
partialText: As the temporary closure of Most Holy Redeemer Church stretches on, congregants fear it will suffer the same fate as other shuttered houses of worship.
